its refusal rules are proven in-process in the cli cell: a report restating a recorded submit or verdict, the ten-minute window, and integration evidence
a lost reply is recovered once from the ordered log without a second post, each operation (add, submit note, verify, edit, merge) alike, in the outbox cell against a stand-in relay
a refused move's lost reply surfaces the original rule after the winner and three replicas agree on the order and every receipt, in the outbox cell against a stand-in relay
a head containing another item's unverified submitted commit is refused with STACKED_ON_UNVERIFIED, proven in process on real git and a real board
a recovered descriptor with no durable receipt stays pending and is never taken as an outcome, and a mismatched ciphertext is not a reply, in the outbox cell against a stand-in relay

a rejected head stays unverified after a sibling resubmission until the latest head is accepted, proven in the store cell on a real board; the refusal on that head is proven in apps/cli/tests/io/submit/stack.test.js

submit and accept both refuse through refuseUnverifiedStack; the cli cell proves it on real git and a board file for a submitted base, an unsubmitted base, the base's own item, an unreadable trunk and a base already merged into trunk
the cadence policy's validation and its two exact due boundaries (age and count) are proven in the landing cell on a board seeded with real verdict rows, without submitting items through the CLI
a future engine move is refused before the cursor advances and leaves every replica unchanged, with the engine-version and upgrade wording, proven in the moves cell
the same ten-round paired claim loop as the kept golden replica race, run over item ids eleven to twenty; the race and its refusal receipts are proven once
a slow tour names its three slowest steps with their times, the slowed git commit among them, proven on the step ranking and labelling in the cli cell instead of a tour with a 15 s sleeping git shim

the merge-in refusal and its control run on real git and a board file in the cli cell (stack.test.js); the ITEM_PATCH_SOURCE next step runs in apps/cli/tests/io/commands/patch-source.test.js, without the gated first submission
